item.description: - Pin threads to keep important work close at hand, with a shorter recent-thread list for each project. - Copy transcript messages and follow live turn progress. Submitted messages appear immediately, and streamed responses keep a steadier layout. - Choose models for review fixes, retain review filters as you navigate, and see a review log scoped to the selected pull request. - Enjoy clearer review actions, severity badges, refresh indicators, and Auto Fix startup status. Pull is disabled for merged pull requests. - The right-hand panel remembers its width across relaunches. - Open plan usage from Status, check Git and GitHub CLI availability, and see whether a Decisions API key is configured in Settings.

# What’s new in Kulula 0.9.0
- Get a system notification when a thread needs your input or finishes in the background. - Refresh pull request findings manually, and find closed pull requests under the History filter. - See Claude session limits and clearer usage warnings in Status. - Keep composer drafts when switching threads, navigate suggestions with the keyboard, and use slash action suggestions after model mentions. - Select inline transcript notes and read longer approval commands without truncation. - Continue thread work after a worktree moves or is lost.

# What’s new in Kulula 0.8.0
- Choose Claude or Codex, and a model, for local pull request reviews. - New subthreads inherit the selected engine and model. You can choose the branch where a subthread starts. - The sidebar shows the model last used in each thread, and you can switch models while continuing a provider conversation. - Composer suggestions make it quicker to enter supported commands and mentions. - Copy a completed turn from the transcript. Inline code is now easier to read. - Pull request review state is retained when you switch threads, and the app refreshes branch divergence after an engine turn. - Auto Fix reports its progress more clearly and handles interrupted Gemini output as a failed fix.
